label: Whatever has the nine SIMPLE_4, PERFECT_2, INFINITE_1 attributes is BLESSED_2
paraphrase: Whatever is simple, universally perfect, supremely good, such that whatever is GOD_4 is it (uniqueness only), infinite, altogether immutable, eternal, and has intellect and will is BLESSED_2: it has intellect, is universally perfect, is good as to being and is IN_ACT_3 in the respect of understanding (InAct g understanding, definition 39f50105, formal or virtual). Derived (nineAreBlessedByUnderstanding) from two existing open premises of DeiFiliusOperationFromIntellect (intellect is the POTENCY_3 capacity to understand; that capacity is exercised or in POTENCY_2 to understanding) with the nine's pure act. BLESSED_2 is not BLESSED_1: ex se, self-knowledge of one's own sufficiency and formal (rather than merely virtual) understanding are not typed. BLESSED_1 is read the Thomist way (beatitude formally in the intellect, q.26 a.2); a Scotist reading (beatitude formally in the will's enjoyment) would be a further sense, not typed here.
